stemMd: A cyclist travels 24 km at 12 km/h and returns along the same route at 8 km/h. What is the average speed in km/h for the entire trip, excluding stops?
explanationMd: The two legs take 2 and 3 hours. Total distance is 48 km and total time is 5 hours, giving 9.6 km/h. Equal distances do not justify taking the arithmetic mean of speeds.
